citations.assessment: The anonymous member of the sages puts an objection to Rava about handling wool used to insulate a pot.
The checked Rashi explains that he first came to the study house that day.
The internal entry discusses this identification and the Bavli names Idi in the distinct account of attending a study house for one day.
The preceding passage names Yaakov bar Idi as the person who placated Rabbi Yochanan. Heilprin’s preceding clause explicitly calls Yaakov the colleague.
The local heading is the supplied cross-reference to Yaakov bar Idi. The exact Yevamot quotation is linked separately.

holds.reason: The second explanation, entry into office, is preserved from Heilprin’s report. Locate the Rashi witness or other source for that explanation.

The separate anecdotes support the distinction between an explicitly named student of Yochanan and Rava’s anonymous interlocutor. Preserve Heilprin’s geographical and chronological objections as arguments rather than independent identity findings.
